nodes.body: <<FILL role=setup words=70 beats='Miri arrives Monday morning to feed the three school hens. Big brown Bess clucks hello. Orange Pepper pecks grain. But small gray Lucy is gone from the henhouse.'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=70 beats='Miri finds a gap in the fence by the rose bushes. A chicken could squeeze through easily. She feels worried but determined.'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=70 beats='Mrs. Chen listens and nods. She tells Miri Lucy may have escaped through the fence. She gives Miri a bag of sunflower seeds. Lucy loves these seeds.'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=70 beats='Miri walks through the park calling Lucy softly and shaking the seed bag. A girl on a bike stops and asks if she can help.'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=70 beats='Miri walks to the blue house next to school. An old man is sweeping his porch. He smiles and listens to her story carefully.'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=70 beats='The girl and Miri search the park paths together calling and calling. Under an old oak tree, they spot gray feathers on the ground.'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=60 beats='Miri pushes through tall bushes. A rabbit darts out. Only leaves and dirt here, no hen.'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=70 beats='In the old man's big garden, Miri spots gray feathers under a tomato plant. She hears soft clucking from behind the shed.'>>
<<FILL role=decision words=70 beats='The feathers lead deeper into trees. By a stream, Miri sees movement in the ferns. She takes a breath and steps closer very slowly.'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=70 beats='Near the pond, Miri sees water birds and a turtle. Then a flutter of gray and white on a rock in the middle of the water!'>>
<<FILL role=climax words=70 beats='Miri finds Lucy in a dust bath behind the shed, warm and dusty. Lucy clucks and hops toward her. Miri scoops her up safely.'>>
<<FILL role=climax words=70 beats='In the ferns, Lucy stops running. Miri kneels and makes soft clucking sounds. Lucy hops toward her and Miri catches her warm and safe.'>>
<<FILL role=decision words=70 beats='Cold water splashes Miri as she wades slowly toward the rock. Lucy flaps and squawks. Miri reaches her and grabs her muddy but safe.'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=70 beats='Miri finds a man fixing his fence nearby. She tells him about Lucy. He smiles, gets a long stick, and helps her reach the rock safely.'>>
<<FILL role=ending words=70 beats='Mrs. Chen hugs Miri and thanks her. Lucy is safe and hungry. The old man becomes a friend. Miri learns neighbors help when you ask.'>>
<<FILL role=ending words=70 beats='The girl walks Miri back to school with Lucy. Mrs. Chen is relieved and grateful. The girl becomes Miri's best friend. They visit often.'>>
<<FILL role=ending words=70 beats='Mrs. Chen laughs at wet Miri and muddy Lucy. Lucy is safe and hungry. Miri learns that small hens can be tough and brave.'>>
<<FILL role=ending words=70 beats='The man is happy he could help. Mrs. Chen thanks him warmly. Lucy gets treats. Miri fixes the fence gap so it never happens again.'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=70 beats='Miri tells Mrs. Chen immediately. Mrs. Chen says they must search right away. She gives Miri advice about where hens like to hide and rest.'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=70 beats='Following Mrs. Chen's tips, Miri checks dark sheds, low bushes, and quiet gardens. She makes a clever search route through town.'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=70 beats='The old shed is dark and cool. Miri calls softly. In the corner behind boxes, she sees movement and hears a familiar cluck.'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=70 beats='The overgrown garden is peaceful. Miri hears soft peeping between the weeds. Lucy is there pecking at seeds, looking happy and safe.'>>
<<FILL role=climax words=70 beats='Lucy was hiding in the shed behind boxes, scared and confused. Miri scoops her up gently and talks to her softly as they walk home.'>>
<<FILL role=climax words=70 beats='Lucy looks up and clucks happily at Miri. She hops over and Miri picks her up warm and dusty from her rest in the garden.'>>
<<FILL role=ending words=70 beats='Mrs. Chen checks Lucy carefully. Lucy is fine, just scared from the dark shed. Miri feels proud of her detective work and her courage.'>>
<<FILL role=ending words=70 beats='Lucy pecks happily in the henhouse again. Miri thanks Mrs. Chen for the good advice. She learns that listening carefully helps you solve problems.'>>
